item.title: Well thought out complications
item.content:encoded:
The dehydration happens due to the mouth and nose being covered, so drinking is impossible without medical intervention.

The antibiotics and removing teeth seem to necessary due to the bacteria that even healthy mouths are completely saturated with. Not being able to rinse your mouth periodicly means that your teeth are loosing the battle to the caustic byproducts of those bacteria, even bypassing the possible illnesses that could be caused, you still are dealing with tooth decay. A little known fact, the number one cause of suicides in undeveloped countries is toothaches, and without treatment, cavities th at reach the root can lead to fatal blood poisoning. Therefore preemptive tooth removal, likely laparoscopic surgery through the cheek, is in the best interests of the survival and quality of life for the subjects. Besides, it isn't like they are using their teeth.

+1 for great details

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
You have done right with this SCP entry, it is indeed unsettling. I'd like to help you by pointing out that it's better to modify genes for nucleotids or nitrogenated bases, viruses are simple DNA or RNA molecules enveloped by proteines and have no genes, the HIV virus is a retrovirus, it makes me think that SCP 340 has some of the mechanics of said virus in it. Just wanting to help out ^^

Aside from that, good job on this SCP entry, I can imagine how having such a membrane would feel.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I imagined the original intent was to have the membrane detach cleanly when the person leaves water, so they could simply go back to breathing air. Unfortunately, the original creators couldn't figure out how to stop the stuff from being produced, and couldn't stop it from hardening on air contact.

I had a head cold for like six weeks over the winter holidays, and the idea cross-pollinated with that stuff from the TV show Fringe that I don't like remembering and with a scene from a Star Wars novel. It worked out rather well ^_^
